english.title: Occupier / manager of smoke-free school grounds fail to display sign - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who occupied or was concerned in the management of premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), which were smoke-free by virtue of section 10 of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017 and that adjoined **(..SPECIFY SCHOOL..), failed to ensure that at least one sign was displayed at the premises which contained a legible graphic representation of a burning cigarette enclosed in a circle with a bar across the circle which crosses the cigarette symbol and was displayed in a prominent position at or near

(A)_[the main entrance]_
(B)_[each of the main entrances]_

and which included the appropriate warning text
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 14(1)(a), (2) and (3) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020 and section 17(1), (5) and (8) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.

english.notes:
(i) The full required 'appropriate warning text' can be found in regulation 14(3) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020).
(ii) For defences to this offence, see section 17(6) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.
(iii) The fixed penalty amount is £200 (regulation 20(a) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020); the discounted amount £150 (regulation 21(a)). For the form of the fixed penalty notice, see regulation 22.
